Here is how to move safely when an agent client reads, edits, or dispatches work locally. The dangerous kind of AI-agent upgrade is the one that looks boring in a release note. A team sees a new preview identifier, changes one configuration value, and deploys. The agent still returns a polished final message. Everyone relaxes. items.title: Odd Lots: Maybe AI Won’t Kill Us All — Just Some of Us
items.summary: Big Tech has been sounding alarms about the risk of AI causing human extinction but there are also skeptics who dismiss the notion, like former US Federal Trade Commissioner Alvaro Bedoya, who referenced the Black Death to dismiss warnings of existential risks. On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast recorded live at the Vermont Hollywood theater, Rachel Karten, author of the Link in Bio newsletter, and Taylor Lorenz, founder of User Mag, talk about the possibility of AI killing all humans, or maybe just some. (Source: Bloomberg)
